feeds.title: Caltrain HSR Blog
feeds.description: This blog exists to discuss compatibility between HSR and Caltrain, integration issues, and the impact on adjoining communities. We are here to quantify the service benefit of capital improvements, to compare and prioritize them by how much better train service results.

feeds.title: Streetsblog California » High Speed Rail
feeds.description: Streetsblog is a daily news source, spreading information about High-Speed Rail, sustainable transportation, and livable communities. Our reporters have broken important stories about transit funding, pedestrian safety, and bicycle policy. And also we are writing on various topics like parking prices and induced traffic which is accessible to a broad audience.

feeds.title: Northeast Maglev Blog
feeds.description: The Northeast Maglev is a US owned company and committed to bringing the worlds fastest train, capable of linking Washington DC and New York in an hour at speeds of over 300 mph. The company is led by a team of executives with extensive experience in project development, engineering, construction, and finance.

feeds.title: Global Railway Review » High Speed Rail
feeds.description: Find articles & news featured on high-speed rail written by senior heads. Global Railway Review one is of the leading sources of information and analysis in the rail sector. We are covering all the News stories and reports referencing HSR on Global Railway Review, new technologies, developments, trends, and challenges within this sector.

feeds.title: Progressive Railroading » High Speed
feeds.description: The high speed rail section features news, reports and features for rail industry professionals. We are Progressive Railroading Magazine, the rail industry's premier information source on High-speed rail. Reporting covers critical industry areas freight, transit, mechanical, engineering, communications & signaling, finance, labor, technology, and many more.

feeds.title: High-Speed Rail Group Blog
feeds.description: High-Speed Rail Group is committed to supporting the successful delivery of a world-class high-speed rail network in Britain. Our unique set of expertise in engineering, operations, funding, and regulation gives us the experience to ensure the extension of the high-speed rail network leaves a lasting legacy for the UK.

feeds.title: RailPAC » High Speed
feeds.description: RailPAC offers articles where high-speed rail is the concentrated topic. RailPAC is a statewide membership organization working for the development and progress of rail passenger service in California and Nevada. The mission of the organization is passenger rail advocacy.

feeds.title: TRANSDEF » High Speed
feeds.description: This site is where TRANSDEF posts recent development information on High-Speed Rail, Climate Change, and bay area transportation. TRANSDEF is a non-profit environmental organization created by transit activists to advocate for better solutions to transportation, land use, and air quality problems. TRANSDEF offers a repository of ideas on how to achieve a better and more sustainable future by shifting where transportation funding goes.

feeds.title: Euronews » High Speed Train
feeds.description: This section of Euronews covers articles and information on high-speed trains along with other related topics such as mobility and travel news. Euronews is Europe's leading international news channel, providing global, multilingual news with a European perspective. We believe that we supply unbiased, multifaceted, factual, and verified information.

feeds.title: CA High-Speed Rail Authority Newsroom
feeds.description: The California High-Speed Rail Authority is responsible for planning, designing, building, and operating of the nation's first high-speed rail system. California's high-speed rail will connect the mega-regions of the state, contribute to economic development and a cleaner environment, create jobs, and preserve agricultural and protected lands.
